title: Adjustment-Anchor Dependence in Formulaic Alpha Languages: A Certified Grammar and a Re-Anchoring Audit
summary: A historical-data replay of AI-mined factor pools reports sensitivity to adjustment anchors for most pools, a limited retrospective data-vintage result. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
